ops.does: Drop and create T_ORDER_AMT (ORDER_ID INTEGER, CUST_ID INTEGER, AMOUNT TEXT, NOTE TEXT, STATUS TEXT)
implicit: output table through Tables.out, including DDL

ops.does: Read ORDERS ordered by ORDER_ID and skip orders with quantity 0 because GSkipVoid is True
implicit: GSkipVoid is set True in FormCreate (Common.gSkipVoid)
QTY NULL is 0 so it is skipped too

ops.does: Amount = Qty*Price, then minus Amt*Disc/100, all as Currency
implicit: Currency: BigDecimal scale 4 HALF_EVEN after every operation in legacy order
UNIT_PRICE REAL read AsCurrency (rounded to 4 decimals), NULL is 0
Amt*Disc/100 is Currency*Integer then / 100 assigned to Currency; keep the intermediate at scale 4 in the order (Amt*Disc) then /100; confirm rounding mode of the division by the dual run

ops.does: AMOUNT text = CentsToStr(Round(Amt*100)): sign, whole part, '.', two digits
implicit: Cents negated before div/mod, so negative amounts format as -x.yy

ops.does: Insert ORDER_ID, CUST_ID, AMOUNT, NOTE, STATUS row
